subject: Control crosswalk & implementation questions (ISO/FedRAMP alignment)
messages:
From: Riya Patel <riya.patel@clearwater-fin.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: eng-support@clearwater-fin.com, clara.jensen@clarity-audits.com
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + control crosswalk for ISO 27001 & FedRAMP readiness

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed with our procurement and security teams, Clearwater wants to validate how Redwood's existing ISO 27001 controls align to a FedRAMP boundary we're considering. We're preparing a short crosswalk and would like a few clarifications so we can scope the evidence request and auditor interviews: 

1) Which of Redwood's ISO control owners are the primary contacts for system configuration, KMS, and incident response?
2) Do you have an internal mapping (control crosswalk) that shows ISO controls -> FedRAMP controls -> evidence artifacts? If so, can you share a template or example?
3) For the FedRAMP intake, do you anticipate needing configuration snapshots (AMI/container images) or are high-level architecture diagrams + config runbooks sufficient for our initial scoping?
4) Timeline question: if we were to target an initial audit window in Q1 2027, what lead time would you recommend for evidence collection/sampling?

Also, Clara from our side (auditor) is copied and will want to know how you typically structure sample windows and control sampling for combined ISO/FedRAMP engagements.

Can you send a short response by end of day Friday? If it's easier, we'll set a 30-min call.

Thanks,
Riya Patel
Head of InfoSec, Clearwater Financial

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Riya Patel <riya.patel@clearwater-fin.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, clara.jensen@clarity-audits.com
Date: 2026-09-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + control crosswalk for ISO 27001 & FedRAMP readiness

Hi Riya / Clara —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers below and a proposal for next steps. More details attached (control-mapping-template.xlsx + a short FedRAMP prelim gap PDF).

1) Primary owners:
- System configuration / infra: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai)
- KMS / key handling: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai)
- Incident response: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.ai)

2) Yes — we maintain a crosswalk that maps ISO clauses to common FedRAMP controls and the typical evidence artifacts. I've attached a sanitized template you can reuse; it includes recommended artifact examples and owner fields.

3) For initial scoping our auditors usually ask for architecture diagrams, high-level configuration runbooks, and sample configuration snapshots for stateful components (e.g., KMS policies, VPC/subnet ACLs, container images). Full AMI images are not required at intake unless the auditor requests binary-level sampling.

4) Timeline: for a combined ISO/FedRAMP intake targeting a Q1 audit window, plan for ~10-12 weeks of evidence collection and sampling prep from the point of kickoff (can shrink if you pre-label owners and have readily accessible logs). If you want, we can provide a compressed checklist for accelerated intake.

Proposed next steps:
- We can run a 30-min scoping call to walk the template (Marcus + Karthik + Grace).
- Clearwater to populate the attached template with owner names and any existing artifacts.
- Redwood to return a prioritized evidence ask and suggested sample windows.

When would you be available for a call? I'm available tomorrow 10:00-11:30 PT or Tuesday afternoon.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: control-mapping-template.xlsx (xlsx - sanitized), fedramp-prelim-gap.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Clearwater crosswalk — quick asks before scoping call

Team —

Clearwater wants to understand how our ISO controls map to FedRAMP and what artifacts they should expect in an intake. Call scheduled Tuesday 2026-09-07 at 1:00pm PT (30m). Goal is to leave them with a prioritized evidence list and a suggested 10-week intake plan.

Pre-work I need from each of you by EOD Monday: 
- Marcus: short bullet list of where config state lives and where we can snapshot (examples: IaC repos, runtime images, infra state file locations). Two-line owner for each item.
- Karthik: KMS key flows, key rotation artifacts, and any HSM/KMS attestations we have. If you can include a sample policy snippet in the template that helps.
- Grace: incident response runbook pointer + typical timeline for evidence requests related to IR (e.g., time to pull/redact incident logs).

Also flag anything we should not share at intake (PII/third-party images) so I can call it out in the template. We'll produce a 'clean' evidence ask for their procurement/audit team.

Thanks — Priya

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-06T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Clearwater crosswalk — quick asks before scoping call

Priya —

Sending the pre-work summary inline (short bullets) so you can paste into the template: 

- Config state locations:
  * IaC: terraform modules in git (repos: infra-core, infra-services). Owners: infra-eng@redwood.ai (primary: Marcus Lin).
  * Runtime manifests: K8s manifests stored in private registry + helm charts (artifact store: artifactory/prod-helm). Owners: infra-sre (contact: sres@redwood.ai).
  * Container images: image registry (gcr.redwood.ai) with tags; we can provide signed SBOMs for representative images.

- Snapshot approach: provide sanitized manifests + policy snippets and representative image SBOMs; full AMI/containers only on auditor request.

Attachments: sample-sbom.txt (stub) — note this is a summarized SBOM we can share with NDA.

Happy to walk through on Tuesday.

— Marcus

From: Riya Patel <riya.patel@clearwater-fin.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: clara.jensen@clarity-audits.com, eng-support@clearwater-fin.com
Date: 2026-09-08T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + control crosswalk for ISO 27001 & FedRAMP readiness

Priya / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the template — that was helpful. Confirming Tuesday 9/7 at 1:00pm PT worked well for us (we reviewed the template during the call). Next asks from our side:

- We'll populate the crosswalk with owner names and return it by 2026-09-14.
- Clara (auditor) asked if you can pre-identify any control areas where Redwood uses third-party managed services (we need to include shared-responsibility notes).
- Can you include a short note on your evidence retention periods for logs/telemetry (syslog, application logs, audit trails)? Clara will use that to propose sampling windows.

We'll attach our vendor questionnaire (SIG-lite) to the filled template; expect it back with your proposed sample windows.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Riya
